## Stage 1: ContentValidator (`/home/dev/repos/my-tools/build-your-own-radar/src/util/contentValidator.js`)

Called on column names after CSV parse. Two checks:

**`verifyContent()` (line 17-20)**
- `MalformedDataError` with message `MISSING_CONTENT` — thrown when `columnNames.length === 0` (the CSV has no columns at all).

**`verifyHeaders()` (line 23-33)**
- `MalformedDataError` with message `MISSING_HEADERS` — thrown if any of `['name', 'ring', 'quadrant', 'description']` are absent.
- `MalformedDataError` with message `MISSING_HEADERS` — thrown if **both** `isNew` AND `status` are missing (at least one must be present).

## Stage 2: InputSanitizer (`/home/dev/repos/my-tools/build-your-own-radar/src/util/inputSanitizer.js`)

Applies to each row/blip after validation. **No errors thrown here** — sanitization is silent.

- `trimWhiteSpaces()`: trims whitespace from all keys and values (line 22-28)
- `description` field: sanitized with `relaxedOptions` allowing `b, i, em, strong, a, h1-h6, li, ul, br, p, u` with `href/target/rel` attributes (line 33)
- `name`, `isNew`, `status`, `ring`, `quadrant`: sanitized with `restrictedOptions` — **all HTML tags stripped**, only `&` replaced with `&` (lines 34-38)

## Stage 3: plotRadarGraph — Ring/Quadrant Mapping (`/home/dev/repos/my-tools/build-your-own-radar/src/util/factory.js:103-151`)

**Ring Normalization (line 119):**
- If feature toggle `normalizeRingNameHoldToCaution` is on (default: true), calls `normalizeRingNameHoldToCaution()` which maps `"hold"` or `"caution"` (case-insensitive) to `"Caution"`. No error — silent normalization.

**Quadrant & Ring validation via `validateInputQuadrantOrRingName()` (lines 96-101):**
- Converts input to lowercase, normalizes `and`/`&` separators to ` & `, then does a case-insensitive match against the 4 canonical names from `graphConfig.rings` and `graphConfig.quadrants`.
- Returns the matched canonical name, or **`undefined`** if no match.

**Blip assignment (lines 118-133):**
- If both `currentQuadrant` and `ring` are truthy → blip is created and added to the quadrant.
- If either is falsy → **blip is silently skipped** (no error thrown, no warning).

**Radar model validation (at plot/graph time):**

- `MalformedDataError` with `TOO_MANY_QUADRANTS` — thrown if more than 4 quadrants are added.
